test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about the line graph CANNOT be inferred?

options.text: The number of candidates qualifying in 1995 is the same as the number of candidates qualifying in 1999.
The highest percentage of candidates qualified in the year 2000.
The lowest percentage of candidates qualified in the year 1994.
The percentage of candidates qualifying has risen in 4 periods and fallen in 2 periods between 1994 and 2000.

solution:
**Given:**

Options provided based on line graph.

**Analysis:**

The number of candidates qualifying in 1995 (60%) is not the same as the number of candidates qualifying in 1999 (50%). This can not be inferred from the graph.

The highest percentage of candidates qualifying is in the year 2000 (80%). This can be inferred from the graph.

The lowest percentage of candidates qualifying is in the year 1994 (35%). This can be inferred from the graph.

The percentage of candidates qualifying has risen in 4 periods and fallen in 2 periods between 1994 and 2000. This can also be inferred from the graph (Risen in 1994-1995, 1996-1997, 1998-1999, 1999-2000; Fallen in 1995-1996, 1997-1998).

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
